description: TerraFusion OS Performance Budget - THE TERRAFUSION WAY

budgets.description: JavaScript bundle size budget (500 KB for modern applications)
CSS bundle size budget (100 KB including Tailwind)
Total image size budget (1 MB including avatars, icons)
Web font size budget (200 KB for custom fonts)

first-contentful-paint.description: FCP - When the first content appears (Core Web Vital)

largest-contentful-paint.description: LCP - When the largest content element appears (Core Web Vital)

cumulative-layout-shift.description: CLS - Visual stability metric (Core Web Vital)

first-input-delay.description: FID - Time from first interaction to browser response (Core Web Vital)

time-to-interactive.description: TTI - When the page is fully interactive

speed-index.description: Speed Index - How quickly content is visually displayed

total-blocking-time.description: TBT - Total time main thread is blocked

vendor.description: Vendor chunk size (React, React-DOM, third-party libs)

route.description: Individual route chunk size (per lazy-loaded route)

component.description: Individual component chunk size (per lazy-loaded component)

performance-notes.core-web-vitals: Google Core Web Vitals: LCP < 2.5s, FID < 100ms, CLS < 0.1
performance-notes.bundle-optimization: Use code splitting, tree shaking, and lazy loading
performance-notes.image-optimization: Use WebP, responsive images, and lazy loading
performance-notes.the-terrafusion-way: Zero compromises on performance - every millisecond matters!
